newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 14.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
In the past year on the U.S. stock market the fortune of Bill Gates, the Microsoft founder doubled from 8.3 billion stg to 18 billion pounds.
ASTON MARTIN CHIEF QUITS IN POLICY ROW

Aston Martin executive chairman David Price has resigned from his position, allegedly over differences with parent company Ford over plans for Aston's future. He will take up a position as a consultant to a group of companies outside the motor industry.

British Gas is branching out into the home security market in an alliance with Securicor. The partnership aims to offer a range of services from electronic alarms systems to fitting locks and the provision of security guards.
VISA RULES CHANGE "MAY FORCE BRITS OUT OF HK'

Following the Hong Kong handover to Chinese sovereignty in June British workers fear they may have to leave the country. The colonial government is set to abolish current visa privileges which mean that Britons can at present live and work in Hong Kong without a visa for up to 12 months, with extensions a formality.
PRESSURE GROUPS LEAVING THE FRINGES BEHIND

Research conducted by Industrial Research Bureau for crisis management consultancy Control Risks Group has shown that more than 50 percent of European companies believe that pressure groups will have more influence in the next five years whilst only 10 percent reckon their impact will lessen.
